If this card is sent to the GY: You can Set 1 "Unchained" Spell/Trap directly from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Soul of Sharvara" once per turn.

## Underworld Goddess of the Closed World | Link Monster LIGHT Fiend LvNone 3000/None | TCG:-
4+ Effect Monsters
You can also use 1 monster your opponent controls as material to Link Summon this card. If this card is Link Summoned: You can negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls. This Link Summoned card is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, unless they target this card. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect that Special Summons a monster(s) from the GY (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation.

## Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens | Link Monster DARK Machine LvNone 0/None | TCG:-
2+ Effect Monsters
You can also use 1 monster in your hand as material to Link Summon this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY, or if all materials used for its Link Summon were monsters you controlled, you can send 1 monster from your Extra Deck instead. During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 monster from your GY to your hand.
